newsitem.title: UK: UK meals and feeds unchanged and quiet.
newsitem.headline: UK meals and feeds unchanged and quiet.

text.p: UK meals and feeds prices started the week unchanged on Monday with most players awaiting the reopening of the Chicago market following Friday's holiday.
No business was reported and brokers said buyers were unlikely to make a move following the sharply lower opening in the U.S. during Monday afternoon.
"The weather is looking good over there and people are sitting back waiting for Chicago to bottom out again," said one.
